title: Box Inventory Unlabeled Rate
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=box:inventory box_id=* room_label=*
| eval unlabeled=if(isnull(room_label) OR room_label="",1,0)
| stats sum(unlabeled) as unlabeled_boxes, count as total_boxes
| eval unlabeled_pct=round(100*unlabeled_boxes/total_boxes,1)
description: Measures what percentage of packed moving boxes lack a room label in the inventory scan.
value: Unlabeled boxes turn unpacking into a guessing game that adds hours on move-in day.
implementation: Scan each box into `box:inventory` with `box_id` and `room_label` before the truck loads.
visualization: Gauge of percent unlabeled boxes with total count.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how many moving boxes still do not say which room they belong in.
